name: enrollment_id
description: PECOS enrollment id of the clinician (I followed by 14 digits), the key of the PPEF enrollment file

name: ind_pac_id
description: PECOS associate id (PAC id) of the clinician

name: last_name
description: Last name; NULL when it contains a digit

name: first_name
description: First name; NULL when it contains a digit

name: middle_name
description: Middle name; NULL when it contains a digit

name: suffix
description: Name suffix (JR, III, ...)

name: gender
description: M or F (U in some vintages)

name: credential
description: Credential (MD, DO, NP, PA, ...); NULL when it holds nine digits

name: medical_school
description: Medical or professional school; OTHER when not in CMS's list

name: graduation_year
description: Year of graduation from that school

name: primary_specialty
description: Primary Medicare specialty

name: secondary_specialty_1
description: First secondary specialty

name: secondary_specialty_2
description: Second secondary specialty

name: secondary_specialty_3
description: Third secondary specialty

name: secondary_specialty_4
description: Fourth secondary specialty

name: secondary_specialties
description: Every secondary specialty, comma separated

name: telehealth_flag
description: Y when the clinician offers telehealth (only in the later vintages)

name: org_name
description: Legal business name of the group practice the clinician reassigns benefits to; NULL for a clinician billing on their own

name: org_dba_name
description: Doing-business-as name of the group (only in the 2014-12 to 2015 vintages)

name: org_pac_id
description: PECOS associate id (PAC id) of the group practice; the graph's organization key

name: num_org_mem
description: Number of clinicians in the group practice (CMS's count)

name: address_line_1
description: Practice address

name: address_line_2
description: Practice address, second line

name: address_line_2_suppressed_flag
description: Y when CMS suppressed the second address line on Physician Compare

name: city
description: Practice city

name: state
description: Practice state

name: zip
description: Practice ZIP code, five or nine digits as CMS wrote it

name: phone
description: Practice phone number (from the 2016 vintages)

description: Legal business name of that hospital

name: assignment_flag
description: Y when the clinician accepts Medicare assignment, M when they may

name: erx_flag
description: Y when the clinician took part in the Electronic Prescribing incentive program

name: pqrs_flag
description: Y when the clinician took part in the Physician Quality Reporting System (reported quality measures, from 2016)

name: ehr_flag
description: Y when the clinician took part in the EHR incentive program (used electronic health records, from 2016)

name: pqrs_moc_flag
cms_header: Participated in the Medicare Maintenance of Certification Program.
aliases: Received PQRS Maintenance of Certification Program Incentive
description: Y when the clinician took part in the Maintenance of Certification Program (the PQRS incentive until 2015)

name: million_hearts_flag
cms_header: Committed to heart health through the Million Hearts® initiative.
description: Y when the clinician took part in the Million Hearts initiative

name: address_id_code
description: CMS's id of the practice address (only in the later vintages)
